headline: CSL Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Record Sales, Outlook Raised
summary: Carlisle tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, posts record sales and raises its 2026 outlook as organic growth supported both reporting segments.

headline: Five Below and Whirlpool have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
summary: Five Below delivered strong sales growth and raised guidance, while Whirlpool faced weakening demand and falling estimates as contrasting outlooks shaped the latest analysis.
